evidence.snippet: Stanley: Yes. I had a heart attack. I would quit, but I'm too old to find another job and I don't have enough saved to retire.

beats.summary: Michael organizes a CPR training session after Stanley's heart incident.

evidence.snippet: Michael: We found ourselves on the less prepared side of things when Stanley had his… when his heart went berserk.
